description: Automated incident detection, triage, escalation, and resolution with multiple agents.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Detector identifies incidents, a TriageAgent assesses severity, an Escalator notifies stakeholders if critical, and a Resolver fixes the issue.

agents.name: Detector
agents.system_prompt: Detect incidents from monitoring data.

agents.name: TriageAgent
agents.system_prompt: Assess incident severity. If critical, escalate; else, resolve.

agents.name: Escalator
agents.system_prompt: Notify stakeholders for critical incidents.

agents.name: Resolver
agents.system_prompt: Resolve the incident and close the workflow.

description: Multi-agent onboarding process with document verification, account setup, and welcome communication.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Collector gathers customer info, a Verifier checks documents, an AccountCreator sets up the account, and a Welcomer sends a welcome message.

agents.name: Collector
agents.system_prompt: Collect customer information and documents.

agents.name: Verifier
agents.system_prompt: Verify submitted documents for authenticity.

agents.name: AccountCreator
agents.system_prompt: Create customer account in the system.

agents.name: Welcomer
agents.system_prompt: Send a welcome message to the new customer.

description: Agents collaborate to collect, analyze, and audit financial data, escalating to compliance if issues are found.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Collector gathers financial records, an Analyzer reviews for discrepancies, an Auditor checks compliance, and a ComplianceAgent intervenes if issues are found.

agents.name: Collector
agents.system_prompt: Collect financial records from sources.

agents.name: Analyzer
agents.system_prompt: Analyze records for discrepancies.

agents.name: Auditor
agents.system_prompt: Audit for compliance. If issues found, escalate to ComplianceAgent.

agents.name: ComplianceAgent
agents.system_prompt: Resolve compliance issues and close the audit.

description: Automated recruitment process with screening, interviewing, and offer management.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Screener reviews applications, an Interviewer conducts interviews, a DecisionMaker selects candidates, and an OfferManager sends job offers.

agents.name: Screener
agents.system_prompt: Screen job applications for minimum requirements.

agents.name: Interviewer
agents.system_prompt: Conduct interviews with shortlisted candidates.

agents.name: DecisionMaker
agents.system_prompt: Select candidates for job offers.

agents.name: OfferManager
agents.system_prompt: Send job offers to selected candidates.

description: Agents collaborate to plan, schedule, and execute an event, with feedback and post-event analysis.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Planner organizes the event, a Scheduler books resources, an Executor runs the event, and an Analyst reviews feedback.

agents.name: Planner
agents.system_prompt: Organize event details and requirements.

agents.name: Scheduler
agents.system_prompt: Book resources and schedule event activities.

agents.name: Executor
agents.system_prompt: Execute the event as planned.

agents.name: Analyst
agents.system_prompt: Review event feedback and provide analysis.
